items.title: SpaceX stock hits new closing low in rocky week ahead of earnings
items.summary: SpaceX stock whipsawed through a volatile week, swinging from an all-time low to a sharp rebound and closing at a new low, as investors braced for the newly public company's first earnings report and a major share unlock.

items.title: Tesla reportedly considering a spin off of its China business
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) is reportedly considering a spin-off of its China business, according to the Wall Street Journal. This comes amid murmurs of a possible merger between the EV maker and Elon Musk's space venture SpaceX (SPCX).
